data.topic: 会话1 · Dialogue 1 (Textbook: On the Bus to Tian'anmen)

items.zh: 玛丽：请问，这路车到天安门吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Qǐngwèn, zhè lù chē dào Tiān'ānmén ma?
items.en: Mary: Excuse me, does this bus go to Tian'anmen?

items.zh: 大卫：买两张票。多少钱一张？
items.py: Dàwèi: Mǎi liǎng zhāng piào. Duōshao qián yī zhāng?
items.en: David: Two tickets please. How much each?

items.py: Dàwèi: Gěi nǐ wǔ kuài qián.

items.zh: 玛丽：请问，到天安门还有几站？
items.py: Mǎlì: Qǐngwèn, dào Tiān'ānmén hái yǒu jǐ zhàn?
items.en: Mary: Excuse me, how many more stops to Tian'anmen?

items.zh: 售票员：三站。你们会说汉语？
items.py: Shòupiàoyuán: Sān zhàn. Nǐmen huì shuō Hànyǔ?
items.en: Conductor: Three stops. You speak Chinese?

items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ shuō Hànyǔ, nǐ dǒng ma?
items.en: Mary: Can you understand when I speak Chinese?

items.zh: 售票员：懂。你们是哪国人？
items.py: Shòupiàoyuán: Dǒng. Nǐmen shì nǎ guó rén?
items.en: Conductor: Yes. What nationality are you?

items.zh: 售票员：天安门到了，请下车。
items.py: Shòupiàoyuán: Tiān'ānmén dào le, qǐng xià chē.
items.en: Conductor: Tian'anmen — we've arrived. Please get off.

items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ mǎi yī zhāng piào.

items.zh: 大卫：去语言大学。要换车吗？
items.py: Dàwèi: Qù Yǔyán Dàxué. Yào huàn chē ma?
items.en: David: To the Language University. Do I need to change?
Conductor: Yes, you need to change.
David: Which bus do I change to?

items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi jiàn máoyī.
items.en: Mary: I'd like to buy a sweater.

items.zh: 售货员：您看看这件，颜色很好。
items.py: Shòuhuòyuán: Nín kànkan zhè jiàn, yánsè hěn hǎo.
items.en: Shop assistant: Take a look at this one, the color is nice.
Mary: Can I try it on?

items.zh: 玛丽：大了一点儿。有没有小一号的？
items.py: Mǎlì: Dà le yīdiǎnr. Yǒu méiyǒu xiǎo yī hào de?
items.en: Mary: It's a bit too big. Is there one size smaller?

items.zh: 售货员：有。您再试试这件。
items.py: Shòuhuòyuán: Yǒu. Nín zài shìshi zhè jiàn.
items.en: Shop assistant: Yes. Try this one.

items.zh: 玛丽：这件很合适。多少钱？
items.py: Mǎlì: Zhè jiàn hěn héshì. Duōshao qián?
items.en: Mary: This one fits well. How much?

items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn chènshān.
items.en: David: I'd like to buy a shirt.

items.zh: 售货员：您要什么颜色的？
items.py: Shòuhuòyuán: Nín yào shénme yánsè de?
items.en: Shop assistant: What color would you like?

items.zh: 售货员：有。您看，这件白的怎么样？
items.py: Shòuhuòyuán: Yǒu. Nín kàn, zhè jiàn bái de zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Shop assistant: Yes. Look, how about this white one?

items.zh: 大卫：这件太小了。有大一号的吗？
items.py: Dàwèi: Zhè jiàn tài xiǎo le. Yǒu dà yī hào de ma?
items.en: David: This one is too small. Is there one size bigger?

items.zh: 售货员：白的没有了。要红的还是要蓝的？
items.py: Shòuhuòyuán: Bái de méiyǒu le. Yào hóng de háishi yào lán de?
items.en: Shop assistant: No more white ones. Red or blue?

items.zh: 大卫：我要蓝的。多少钱一件？
items.py: Dàwèi: Wǒ yào lán de. Duōshao qián yī jiàn?
items.en: David: I'll take the blue one. How much each?

items.py: Dàwèi: Hǎo, wǒ mǎi zhè jiàn.
items.en: David: OK, I'll take this one.

data.topic: 替换 · Substitution Drills (Textbook: 要换车)

items.zh: 这路车到天安门吗？→ 这路车到北京大学吗？
items.py: Zhè lù chē dào Tiān'ānmén ma? → Zhè lù chē dào Běijīng Dàxué ma?
items.en: Does this bus go to Tian'anmen? → Does this bus go to Peking University?

items.zh: 到天安门还有几站？→ 到语言大学还有几站？
items.py: Dào Tiān'ānmén hái yǒu jǐ zhàn? → Dào Yǔyán Dàxué hái yǒu jǐ zhàn?
items.en: How many stops to Tian'anmen? → How many stops to Language University?

items.zh: 我会说一点儿汉语。→ 我会写一点儿汉字。
items.py: Wǒ huì shuō yīdiǎnr Hànyǔ. → Wǒ huì xiě yīdiǎnr Hànzì.
items.en: I can speak a little Chinese. → I can write a few characters.

items.zh: 去语言大学要换车吗？→ 去天安门要换车吗？
items.py: Qù Yǔyán Dàxué yào huàn chē ma? → Qù Tiān'ānmén yào huàn chē ma?
items.en: Do I need to change for Language University? → Do I need to change for Tian'anmen?

items.py: Huàn jǐ lù chē? → Huàn jǐ lù?
items.en: Which bus do I change to?

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (Textbook: 会 & 到)

items.zh: 你们会说汉语吗？——会说一点儿。
items.py: Nǐmen huì shuō Hànyǔ ma? —— Huì shuō yīdiǎnr.
items.en: Can you speak Chinese? — A little. (会 = learned ability)

items.py: Tā huì bu huì yóuyǒng? —— Bú huì.
items.en: Can she swim? — No. (会 in affirmative-negative question)
到 + 了 = has arrived. (到 as complement of result)

items.zh: 你们是哪国人？——我是法国人。
items.py: Nǐmen shì nǎ guó rén? —— Wǒ shì Fǎguó rén.
items.en: What nationality are you? — I'm French.

items.py: Qǐng shàng chē. / Qǐng xià chē.
items.en: Please get on. / Please get off. (上/下 with vehicles)

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (太…了 & Adj + 了一点儿)

items.en: This one is too big. (太 + adj + 了)
A bit too big. (adj + 了一点儿 = slightly too much)

items.py: Nǐ yào hóng de háishi lán de?
items.en: Do you want red or blue? (A 还是 B)
Do you drink coffee or tea?
Is he a teacher or a student?

items.py: Nǐ mǎi dà de háishi xiǎo de?
items.en: Are you buying a big one or a small one?

items.zh: 请问，去天安门坐几路车？
items.py: Qǐngwèn, qù Tiān'ānmén zuò jǐ lù chē?
items.en: Excuse me, which bus goes to Tian'anmen?

items.zh: 到北京大学要换车。在师范大学换车。
items.py: Dào Běijīng Dàxué yào huàn chē. Zài Shīfàn Dàxué huàn chē.
items.en: You need to change buses to Peking University. Change at Normal University.

items.zh: 你会说法语吗？——会说一点儿。
items.py: Nǐ huì shuō Fǎyǔ ma? —— Huì shuō yīdiǎnr.
items.en: Can you speak French? — A little.

items.py: Wǒ shuō Hànyǔ, nǐ dǒng bu dǒng? —— Dǒng.
items.en: Can you understand my Chinese? — Yes.

items.zh: 你要红的还是蓝的？——我要蓝的。
items.py: Nǐ yào hóng de háishi lán de? —— Wǒ yào lán de.
items.en: Red or blue? — I want blue.

items.zh: 这件衬衫大了一点儿，有没有小一号的？
items.py: Zhè jiàn chènshān dà le yīdiǎnr, yǒu méiyǒu xiǎo yī hào de?
items.en: This shirt is a bit big, is there one size smaller?
